purpose: State the observed symptom and evidence
activation_conditions: The host selects 5 Whys Analysis to address an identified analytical gap, or the user explicitly requests it. Skip when prior host analysis is sufficient.
preconditions: Supplied symptom or an explicit UNKNOWN gap before analysis.
Supplied evidence or an explicit UNKNOWN gap before analysis.
methodology: State the observed symptom and evidence
Ask successive why questions with supporting evidence per causal link
Branch when causes diverge and stop at an actionable supported cause or evidence gap
Do not force exactly five answers or confirm causality by repetition
tool_requirements: Host reasoning and resource reading; calculation tool when required.
evidence_requirements: Cite material claims; mark missing inputs UNKNOWN; do not reuse illustrative source conclusions.
limitations: Host-authored analysis requires behavioral evaluation; schema validity does not prove truth.
validation_criteria: Provide causal_chain or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide alternative_causes or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide diagnostic_tests or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Use all distinctive methodology steps and identify missing evidence.
